tools.prompt: Create a 15-second cinematic naval-war scene aboard Resolute, widescreen 16:9. Realistic photography, cold late-afternoon daylight, steel textures, controlled tension and decisive pacing. Five coherent shots preserve Vale, a woman with cropped dark hair, a navy double-breasted coat, and brass binoculars; lookout, a young man with curly black hair, a navy sailor shirt, and a red headset; helmsman, a woman with a blond braid, a navy sailor shirt, and rolled sleeves; bridge, a narrow steel bridge with slanted front windows, a central chart table, and cool overhead lamps; sea, an open slate-blue sea with low swells, a flat horizon, and thin overcast; Resolute, a dark-gray dreadnought battleship with twin-gun main turrets and a red band around its forward funnel; enemy cruiser, a pale-gray cruiser with one raked funnel and a white stripe across its bow; tactical screen, a small square tactical screen with a thick black bezel and amber graphics. 0–3 seconds: medium over-shoulder view, lookout, red headset visible, points out the enemy cruiser through the glass against the sea; lateral slide. 3–6 seconds: tight profile, Vale, binoculars raised, confirms the contact through them, window reflections across her face; slow push in. 6–9 seconds: insert close-up, tactical screen, amber graphics visible, tracks the cruiser with a moving contact marker, steel console surrounding it; gentle push in. 9–12 seconds: medium close-up, Vale, binoculars raised, commands fire, cool lamps behind her; short push in. 12–15 seconds: wide establishing view of the bridge, Vale, binoculars raised, and crew standing still beside the chart table; ease back into a final hold. Sound: low engine rumble, faint hull creaks; 9–12 seconds, Vale says, "Fire main battery!" Hold the final image still for the last two seconds. Cool steel-blue shadows, restrained saturation, warm amber highlights. No subtitles, text overlays, music or gunfire.

story.prose:
Inside a narrow steel bridge with slanted front windows, a central chart table, and cool overhead lamps, Captain Vale, a woman with cropped dark hair, a navy double-breasted coat, and brass binoculars, confirms the contact. The lookout, a young man with curly black hair, a navy sailor shirt, and a red headset, points through the glass at a pale-gray cruiser with one raked funnel and a white stripe across its bow. The helmsman, a woman with a blond braid, a navy sailor shirt, and rolled sleeves, holds course. Beside them sits a small square tactical screen with a thick black bezel and amber graphics. Vale lowers her binoculars: “Fire main battery!”

BIBLE (use these words for these things, every time): captain_vale = a woman with cropped dark hair, a navy double-breasted coat, and brass binoculars; lookout = a young man with curly black hair, a navy sailor shirt, and a red headset; helmsman = a woman with a blond braid, a navy sailor shirt, and rolled sleeves; bridge = a narrow steel bridge with slanted front windows, a central chart table, and cool overhead lamps; sea = an open slate-blue sea with low swells, a flat horizon, and thin overcast; resolute = a dark-gray dreadnought battleship with twin-gun main turrets and a red band around its forward funnel; enemy_cruiser = a pale-gray cruiser with one raked funnel and a white stripe across its bow; tactical_screen = a small square tactical screen with a thick black bezel and amber graphics. Light and grade: Cold late-afternoon daylight, cool steel-blue shadows, restrained saturation, and warm amber screen light; realistic naval-war-film photography..
